import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.notices import build_notice
from rosterkit.models import Student, Mark
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError

PUPIL = Student("7", "Rivera", "Ana", "A")


def _mark(ident, month_day, status):
    return Mark(ident, date(2026, 9, month_day), status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absences_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            _mark("7", 4, "absent"),
            _mark("7", 3, "present"),
            _mark("7", 2, "absent")
        ]
        text = build_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertIn("Ana Rivera missed 2 day(s)", text)
        self.assertIn("2026-09-02, 2026-09-04", text)

    def test_other_student(self):
        marks = [_mark("8", 2, "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        marks = [_mark("7", 2, "late")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, marks)
